description: Change the owner and/or group of each FILE to OWNER and/or GROUP.

option.name: --changes
tip: like verbose but report only when a change is made

option.name: --dereference
tip: affect the referent of each symbolic link (this is the default), rather than the symbolic link itself

option.name: --from
tip: change the ownership of each file only if its current owner and/or group match those specified here. Either may be omitted, in which case a match is not required for the omitted attribute

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: affect symbolic links instead of any referenced file (useful only on systems that can change the ownership of a symlink)

option.name: --recursive
tip: operate on files and directories recursively

option.name: --reference
tip: use RFILE's ownership rather than specifying values. RFILE is always dereferenced if a symbolic link.

option.name: --verbose
tip: output a diagnostic for every file processed

option.name: -H
tip: if a command line argument is a symbolic link to a directory, traverse it

option.name: -L
tip: traverse every symbolic link to a directory encountered

option.name: -P
tip: do not traverse any symbolic links
